_doc: P4 engine switches. Defaults = DESIGN §8 'P4 rulings (2026-10-28)', 'P4 rulings 2', 'P4 rulings 3', 'P4 rulings 4' (as_of_block, mark) and 'P4.1 rulings'. Every key is a switch (override with --set key=value); the engine itself has NO defaults (fifo.Policy raises PolicyRequired). pending_architect lists the proposals still awaiting a ruling.
ruled_in_rulings_3: shortfall: pending lot, basis_origin=unrecorded_inflow, opens at the shortfall block; reported as an UNEXPLAINED GAP
exit: realized NULL (not 0); counted, never summed
gas of an NFT sale (nft_sale / auction seller) comes off the NFT's proceeds
fee_split: equal when any acquisition of the tx is pending (the pending lot keeps its share in fee_usdc)
swap gas goes only into the bought asset's basis
queue_split: one craft-input ref feeding several queues splits equal, flagged
ruled_in_rulings_4: as_of_block: the LAST ledger block by default, or a block user_default chooses (--as-of)
mark: the P3 pricing path writes a mark per held fungible asset at as_of_block (p3_mark); no valid mark -> excluded from unrealized and counted
